title: SDLC Task-Local Reference v1
description: A reference to an addressable entity in the current task payload or result. The value has the form #<entity-kind>/<entity-id>; the identifier-prefix conventions below help agents and humans avoid naming collisions, while host validation resolves the reference against the current task.
$comment: SdlcTaskLocalReference is intentionally local and does not identify a work item or task. Use #outcome/O-001, #element/E-001, or #artifact/ART-001 for entities in the current task. To refer to another task, use SdlcTaskQualifiedReference; to refer across repositories, use SdlcReference. The entity kind is lower-kebab-case. The entity ID begins with an ASCII letter and may contain letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons, and hyphens.

x-identifier-prefix-conventions.description: A requirement considered by the task. Existing work-item requirement IDs may retain their work-item-qualified form.
An acceptance criterion associated with a requirement.
A semantic input evaluated by the task.
An embedded research, decision, analysis, modeling, or review activity.
A generic typed element in a design model.
A named projection of a design model.
A durable design or delivery artifact. ART is the canonical artifact reference prefix.
A task result, conclusion, or downstream handoff.
A question or unresolved question retained for follow-up.
A research finding or other evidence-backed observation.
An alternative evaluated by a decision task.
A risk associated with a task result or decision.
